rules.statement: An action for accounts does not lie unless the principal has first called upon the agent to explain the accounts and the agent refuses or fails to explain them satisfactorily.
rules.supporting_quote: "H. N. G. Fernando, J.- The obligation of an agent to render accounts to his principal does not terminate merely by the submission of account papers he is bound to explain those papers, and if, on accounts taken, it is found that he has in his hands money which belongs to his principal, he is bound to pay that sum."
